description: This file defines the Error class within the Opencart Catalog Controller Startup namespace. It handles error and exception processing, including logging, displaying, and redirecting on errors within the OpenCart system.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Handles system errors and exceptions, logs errors, displays error messages, and redirects to error pages.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes error handling, sets error and exception handlers, and prepares logging.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Handles PHP errors by logging and displaying or redirecting.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Handles uncaught exceptions by logging and displaying or redirecting.
